## Summary

`RunOnce` is declared as a method exactly twice, on two different types (both coincidentally named `Runner`, but in different packages). There are no standalone (receiverless) functions named `RunOnce`, and no occurrences in non-Go files.

## 1. Declaring types

None. This method is never invoked anywhere in the repository.
